about: docs/www-port/pixel.md: the class and the reason of each section of the page at each width, the first rule that matches (section, and widths or scheme when it says). Classes: intentional (a decision of dropped.md, or the baseline look of dropped.md 10), defect (open) (a fault of the port, listed in status.md). A section no rule matches is UNEXPLAINED and fails scripts/pixel-diff-www.js. Written after looking at the crops named in each reason; a section whose reason says nothing was looked at is classified from parity.md (its text is the same) and the baseline decision, not by eye.
